changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Replaced the metadata placeholder with the exact upstream TokenRig inference path and an offline GLB mesh input workflow.
Added the CUDA 13.2 ARM64 native dependency authority and pinned Qwen3 configuration used by TokenRig.
Added a deterministic pure glTF exporter for generated joints, inverse bind matrices, and skin weights.
Marked the rigging checkpoint binding non-executable pending TokenRig source and a model-specific GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated GLB mesh input contract.
Corrected the checkpoint license to MIT.
Initial reviewed catalog release of SkinTokens / TokenRig pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
